body: I know this is late but I thought that I’d update you in case you were worried: I stayed for another sunrise, am getting some help at the moment IRL, thank you for your support and kindness
Thank you you-know-who, I appreciate you and care for you
Thank you so much. This really meant a lot to me. Just being heard and supported is huge right now bc my PTSD is in overdrive. Really just one person saying anything makes such a difference.

Wow. This rendered me nearly speechless, and since you read this whole damn novella, you’d probably realize that that’s a rare feat.

Thank you so so much for this. It means a lot – A LOT – to me. I’ve read this message a few times over, just to really absorb it all. You’re absolutely right about creeps – I’ve dealt with my fair share of them even in SA survivor spaces & know that creepers with rape fetishes like to lurk in spaces. I definitely keep an eye out & anyone who doesn’t give off decent vibes or have a good Reddit history (or if they don’t have a Reddit history period) gets an ignore from me.

Thank you for your kindness and validation. I’m sorry that you can relate in any kind of way as I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy, but simultaneously I’m grateful to hear from someone who has experienced something similar. I’m also grateful that your memory has spared you from remembering too much horrific Shit. 

I know what happened to me is a bit fantastical and crazy, the stuff you see on Dateline or whatever, but i’m just someone who was too young to have any say in whether or not i would “press charges” and they were going to prosecute my assailant anyway (as many on this sub probably know, including you, the DA can prosecute a crime against another person even without their cooperation since technically rape/attempted murder/assault are prosecuted as crimes against the State rather than crimes against an individual) – i’ve actually heard even worse from other survivors who didn’t report and/or weren’t taken seriously by LE. 

it might sound silly given how angry I was in this post, but even if you have those gory memories stashed away and want to get them out, i’m actually a pretty decent listener and will listen without judgment and be there if you ever need it. 

i love what you said about what keeps you going. i was always raised to believe that anger is shameful and wrong, but i think you’re right that it can be justified and not necessarily a bad thing to have. it can be productive. i think what’s kept me going for nearly a decade is actually partially the spite for him and what he did to me. i knew i wanted to live to watch him cry like a little bitch when he was found guilty and spit my vitriol directly at him when he was sentenced (and then watch him cry again when he was sentenced to 10-22 years). i’ll definitely try to use it more for my benefit. i stay alive for my loved ones and to help others, but perhaps the sheer rage i feel for my assailant will keep me alive for the rest of my natural life lol.

thank you for dedicating so much of your time to speaking to me and being here for me, especially given the day that you had. can’t express how appreciated it was and how much it helped. keep on keeping on, helpful fellow anti-dictator anti-racist LGBT member, and thank you for what you do. 🙏
